card.name: Just before metre or meter units
card.fires_on: Words and pieces right before a length or area unit starting with m, such as metres, meter or square meter. It fires on the space or number after 'up to', on 'square', and on the start of 'feet' or 'kilometer'.

modes.description: The gap, 'to' or a number word just ahead of a metre measurement.

modes.description: A spelled-out number directly before metre or meter.

card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to give a distance in metres, and pushes toward the full word rather than the letter m.
